course_name_original: Introduction à la commande adaptative et à la commande en boucle
course_name_en: Introduction to Adaptive Control and Feedforward Control
prerequisites: Systems modeling in the continuous time-domain using differential equations and transfer functions
Stability and performance in the continuous time-domain
PID controllers in the continuous time-domain

learning_outcomes.text: understand some architectures of adaptive control
design and implement a feedforward controller for badly damped mechatronic systems

syllabus_topics: Exercise on adaptive control and feedforward control combined (1h)
Modeling and feedforward control of a piezoelectric mini-UAV which exhibits badly damped vibrations and non-linearity (4h)
Use of Matlab/Simulink on a topic which is related to research (mini-UAV)
bibliography: Micky Rakotondrabe, 'Smart materials-based actuators at the micro/nano-scale: characterization, control and applications', edited book, Springer - Verlag, New York, ISBN 978-1-4614-6683-3, 2013.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
